key_rationale: While headline CPI at 3.54% is within our target, food inflation remains elevated at 5.42%, necessitating continued vigilance to ensure inflation durably aligns with the 4.00% target. Given the robust GVA growth of 6.80% and the need to manage liquidity amidst global spillovers, maintaining the current repo rate and stance of withdrawal of accommodation remains appropriate to anchor inflation expectations.
